WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaingb,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) as avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
all_means AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) as overall_mean_remaingb
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  group_stats.zoneref,
  group_stats.insurstat,
  group_stats.avg_remaingb,
  group_stats.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  CASE 
    WHEN group_stats.avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL AND all_means.overall_mean_remaingb IS NOT NULL
    THEN group_stats.avg_remaingb / all_means.overall_mean_remaingb
    ELSE NULL
  END as ratio
FROM group_stats
CROSS JOIN all_means
WHERE all_means.overall_mean_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
